addendum.created: Addendum created. Generate the PDF from the list
addendum.effectiveDatePlaceholder: e.g. the signing date of this addendum
addendum.temporary: Temporary (automatic return to the old rate)
addendum.revertConditionPlaceholder: e.g. Returns to the previous rate 3 months after the effective date.

clientForm.tenantNotFound: No vanagreen tenant with this id
clientForm.anafFoundWithState: Company found, but its ANAF status is: {{stare}}
clientForm.autoCreatedHint: Client created automatically from VanaGreen. Fill in the billing details.
clientForm.keepIncomplete: Still mark as “incomplete details” (untick on save if you filled in everything)
clientForm.name: Name
clientForm.slugPlaceholder: from the name if left empty
clientForm.platformHint: Decides which invoice templates (Pricing → Templates) are available for this client.
clientForm.createInVanagreen: Also create in VanaGreen (new tenant, uses the slug above)
clientForm.monthsToExtend: Months to extend on a confirmed payment
clientForm.paymentTermHint: The invoice due date (issue date + this term). Empty = uses the global default (Settings → Sequence). Set it only if this client has a contract with a different term.
clientForm.autoIssue: Issue the invoice automatically on the due date above (needs the tenant mapped above)
clientForm.contractData: Contract details (optional, for the Contracts tab)
clientForm.planHint: Modules and price filled in from the bundle; you can edit them below.
clientForm.contractNumberHint: Suggested automatically (last + 1, skipping the reserved ones). Overwrite it if needed.
clientForm.mapPlatformForAddons: Map the client to a platform above to see the add-on catalog.
clientForm.otherAddonsPlaceholder: Others (free text, e.g. E-Factura ANAF SPV). Empty + nothing ticked = None
clientForm.hasFreeMonth: Has a Free Month (the length comes from Settings → Contract templates → Commercial terms)

clients.deleteBody: Invoices already issued stay in the books.
clients.demoHint: Tenants in trial/demo in vanagreen. They show up here automatically, without being invoiced. They move to the table above the next day, once converted (from vanagreen or through a payment confirmed here).
clients.pendingDeletionHint: Tenant terminated in vanagreen. Unless restored from there, it is deleted here automatically 30 days after termination (in step with the purge in vanagreen). Check the unsettled invoices before it disappears.
clients.needBillingInfo_one: {{count}} new client from VanaGreen. Fill in the billing details: {{names}}
clients.needBillingInfo_other: {{count}} new clients from VanaGreen. Fill in the billing details: {{names}}

terms.title: Commercial terms (TERMS)
terms.injectedAtToken: The values injected into the templates at the {{token}} tokens.

templates.blankHint: The documents as PDF without a particular client: the company details and terms are filled in, the client's fields are left empty.
templates.pickHint: Pick a template to edit. The text is HTML source; the PDF is generated from it.
templates.restoreBody: Your text is replaced with the example template from the app and cannot be recovered.
templates.title: Contract templates

contracts.missingData: Details missing for generation (fill them in under Clients → Edit → “Contract details”): {{missing}}
contracts.alreadySigned: You already have a signed {{value}}. Regenerating creates a new document; the signed one stays in the history.

declarations.loadFailed: The data for {{month}} could not be loaded.
declarations.signatureNote: For SPV, download the PDF: it is the ANAF form, already filled in. Open it in Adobe Acrobat Reader, press Validare, sign with your certificate and upload it. The XML and CSV are for the accountant.
declarations.d301Help: Purchases of services under reverse charge (EU and non-EU) in the selected month, due on the 25th of the next month.
declarations.d390Help: EU purchases only (Hetzner etc.); non-EU purchases (Cloudflare etc.) never appear here.

edit.title: Correct {{supplier}}
edit.documentNumberHint: As it appears on the supplier’s invoice, for example “Invoice no.”.
edit.amountInvalid: Enter the amount on the invoice, greater than zero.
edit.typeNone: No reverse charge: the supplier already charged VAT

filing.label: SPV index
filing.notFiled: Not filed yet. Enter the index SPV gives you after the upload.

issued.sentToAnaf: Sent to ANAF. The status updates automatically (polled every 10 min)
issued.uploadIndexHint: Upload index. Look it up on app.anaf.ro/SNMD/facturaProd/RaspunsuriFacturaProd.xhtml
issued.deleteDraftBody: It does not use up an invoice number; the series stays as it is.
issued.markPaidBody: If the client is linked to VanaGreen, its subscription is extended.
issued.deleteDraftForClient: Delete the draft for the client

invoiceForm.templatePricesFailed: The prices from the template could not be resolved
invoiceForm.draftCreated: Invoice draft created. Issue it when it is ready
invoiceForm.pickClient: Pick a client (or add one in the Clients tab)
invoiceForm.rateStillLoading: The BNR rate is still loading for a line in foreign currency. Wait a moment and try again
invoiceForm.resolvingPrices: Computing the prices (may include the price from the client's subscription)…
invoiceForm.templateHint: Pick a template as a starting point; the lines stay editable below before saving.
invoiceForm.rateLoadingInline: (the BNR rate is still loading for a line…)

spv.saved: Message saved. It stays with us even if it disappears from SPV
spv.loadFailed: The SPV messages could not be loaded
spv.empty: No SPV message in the last {{DAYS}} days (or you are on the ANAF test environment; real messages exist only in production).
spv.saveHint: Save. It stays with us even if ANAF deletes the message

past.incomeHint1: For past invoices/payments that are not in e-Factura and cannot come through the ANAF sync; for the record only,
past.incomeHint2: it generates no XML/PDF and is sent nowhere.
past.expenseHint1: For running expenses or invoices received from suppliers that are not (or will not be) in e-Factura;
past.expenseHint2: it generates nothing, for the record only. Tick “already paid” only if that is the case.
past.invoiceDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Invoice F-2025-014, issued by hand
past.reverseChargeHint: Shows up in the D301 declaration of the invoice's month (the “Issue date” field above). EU purchases also show up in D390.

received.empty: No received invoice. Set up ANAF in the Settings tab, then run the sync.

recurring.title: Recurring expenses
recurring.reminderOnlyHint: Calendar reminder only; the real invoice is entered by hand
recurring.deleteBody: It is no longer generated every month. Expenses already created stay.
recurring.reverseChargeHint: Copied to every expense created from it; shows up in D301/D390.
recurring.autoGenerateHint: Untick if the supplier later sends a real invoice that you enter by hand; the job then stays a calendar reminder and no longer doubles the expense.

reserved.digitsOnly: Write the number in digits, four at most.
reserved.reasonRequired: Write what the number is taken for.
reserved.title: Reserved numbers
reserved.hint: Contract numbers taken outside the app. The suggestion for a new client skips them.
reserved.loadFailed: The reserved numbers could not be loaded. Reload the page.

quarterly.title: Quarterly package for the accountant
quarterly.hint: Issued/received invoices, revenue/expenses, unreconciled transactions and the reverse-charge lines of the quarter, packed in a zip with everything already archived automatically. Sending it to the accountant stays manual.

anaf.connectedToast: ANAF connected. The sync runs every hour
anaf.steps: 1. Open the ANAF consent page (in a browser with the digital certificate installed) · 2. Copy the code from the redirect · 3. Paste it below with the company's CIF.
anaf.setEnv: Set {{clientId}} and {{clientSecret}} in {{envFile}} (the OAuth app registered on the ANAF portal), then come back here.

sequence.title: Invoice numbering
sequence.paymentTermHint: The default payment term applies to any invoice without an explicit due date (issue date + this number of days). Clients with a different contract have their own exception in the client record.
sequence.yearlyResetOn: Yearly reset of the numbering: yes. Do not change the format in the middle of the fiscal year without a reason.
sequence.yearlyResetOff: Yearly reset of the numbering: no. Do not change the format in the middle of the fiscal year without a reason.

sign.uploaded: Signed PDF uploaded. It shows up in the list as a new document
sign.title: Sign the document
sign.hint: Open the PDF in a new tab for reference, then drag a rectangle below exactly where you want the signature (the box has the proportions of an A4 page).
sign.uploadSigned: I signed it, upload the PDF
sign.fallbackHint: If the certSIGN token does not work with JSignPdf, sign by hand in Adobe as before and upload the result here anyway.
